title: Savi Over a game
description: My first mod introducing: Savi, Biome and more!
body:
![logo_mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05ce0d1f9156d2355a59f69d28c659173f9ac4ac.png)

**Mod Overview**

A mysterious expansion centered around a powerful entity known as **Savi**, introducing new materials, structures, and a crimson-themed environment.
Features:

**Savi**
- A highly powerful entity that can be tamed
- CUSTOM MOB MODEL
- Think twice before attacking un-tamed Savi

**Structures** - 
Abandoned Laboratory
- Generates in the world
- Contains Savi related valuable loot and experiment notes about Savi

**Equipment**
- Crystal Armor
- Crystal Tools

**New Items**
- Food Pile
- Savi’s Crystal
- Savi’s Crystal Shard
- Savi’s Summoner
- Bloodwood (full set of wood variants)

**Biome** - 
Marked Grove
- A new biome with unique atmosphere and Bloodwood forest
- Full of cats

**Full language support for:**
- English
- Polish
- Italian

**Villager Trading**
New trades added for:
- Butcher
- Wandering Trader

**Credits**
